# Insightly CRM Reviews & Product Details

Visit Website

Insightly is the modern, affordable CRM that teams love. It’s easy to use, simple to customize, and scales with companies as they grow, solving common pain points that legacy CRMs can't. Insightly helps teams build and convert sales pipeline, increase productivity, and build lasting customer relationships.

Centralize and manage all your customer, sales, and business data—leads, contacts, emails,
events, quotes, projects, tasks, opportunities, and business reports—in one easy-to-use,
flexible and secure CRM that scales with your business.

Increase sales efficiency and transparency with Insightly’s enterprise-grade Products, Price
books, and Quotes (PPQ) capabilities. Quickly search, track, and manage millions of distinct
products and services right inside the Insightly platform. Connect products and services to
individual opportunities, eliminating human errors, bottlenecks, and inconsistencies. With
Insightly’s PPQ, your field teams can generate custom quotes, contracts, and proposals for their opportunities with just a few clicks. Enjoy complete control and visibility into what you sell, to whom, when, and at what price.

Use Insightly’s custom objects and apps to tailor workflows and processes to your unique
business needs and preferences, ensuring high adoption and satisfaction.

Use AppConnect to integrate Insightly with more than 500 popular apps. Insightly’s native CRM integrations include:
Gmail
Google Workspace & Google Apps
Google Drive
Quickbooks Online
Xero
Slack
Dropbox
Box
MailChimp
Evernote
Zapier
Facebook Lead Ads
And more...

Manage everything on the go with award-winning mobile applications for both Android and iOS.
Scan business cards and upload all information in one click, update projects and records in real time, and enable your field team to create and update opportunities right at the client's location.

Powerful in any vertical, Insightly CRM customers can add companion products for marketing automation, customer service, and integrations in the same platform. Insightly is trusted by more than a million users worldwide.

"Keeping Customer Workflows Better Connected"

4.5/5

What do you like best about Insightly CRM?

It helps me keep customer information, follow-ups, opportunities, and ongoing activities organized in one place. I work as a Dietician and Nutritionist, manage a homeopathy clinic, and also create health education content. My work involves handling consultation enquiries, wellness program discussions, follow-up communication, and educational outreach activities, so having everything connected inside one system is very useful. What I like most about Insightly CRM is that contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and project-related activities stay linked together. When I receive a new enquiry, I can track the contact, manage follow-ups, schedule activities, and continue organizing related work without losing information between different records. This makes daily CRM work more structured. I regularly use contact management, lead tracking, opportunity management, task management, calendar activities, and reporting features. These help me organize consultation enquiries, monitor follow-up progress, schedule discussions, and keep track of ongoing communication. Having activity history available alongside customer records makes it easier to review previous interactions before the next follow-up.

Another thing I find useful is the way projects and tasks can be managed within the same platform. For health education initiatives and ongoing wellness programs, I can keep activities, deadlines, and related records organized without switching between multiple systems. The system is easy to understand, implementation for everyday use was straightforward, and performance has been smooth during regular work. Moving between contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and projects feels responsive, even when managing multiple records. The available integrations and workflow features also help keep information connected and reduce manual tracking work. Overall, Insightly provides a good balance of CRM, activity management, project tracking, and organization tools. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Insightly CRM?

I like how contacts, opportunities, and projects can be connected together, but sometimes maintaining those relationships requires a little extra setup when records become more detailed. It works well once everything is organized, although the initial record structure can take some time to maintain consistently. For larger workflows this makes sense, but for smaller day to day activities it occasionally feels more detailed than necessary. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Insightly CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

It helps me keep contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and ongoing activities organized in one place instead of managing information across multiple records and tools. Having customer information connected with follow-ups and activity history makes it easier to keep track of ongoing discussions. I use Insightly CRM to manage consultation enquiries, wellness program leads, follow-up communication, and health education related activities. The platform helps me monitor enquiry progress, schedule tasks, manage opportunities, and keep important information available when I need it.

The combination of CRM and project-related tracking is also useful because I can organize ongoing activities, deadlines, and communication without switching between different systems. This helps when managing multiple enquiries and ongoing initiatives at the same time. Having contacts, opportunities, tasks, projects, and activity records connected together improves visibility and reduces the need for manual tracking. It helps me stay organized, follow up more consistently, and manage day-to-day customer and activity management work more efficiently. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

"Efficient CRM with Strong Reporting and Bulk Editing"

4.5/5

What do you like best about Insightly CRM?

The features I use most and find the most valuable are bulk editing and reporting. The bulk editing function saves me a significant amount of time by allowing me to update multiple records at once instead of making changes individually. I also really like the drag‑and‑drop functionality when creating reports, which makes it quick and easy to customize the columns I want to include. An added benefit is how intuitive the platform is overall—the site is easy to navigate across different pages, which helps streamline my daily workflow. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Insightly CRM?

One issue I’ve experienced with Insightly CRM is that when creating reports, filters don’t always work as expected. Even after applying a filter to exclude certain data, those records sometimes still appear in the report. Additionally, Insightly Marketing cannot link email campaigns directly to contacts in Insightly CRM, which makes it more difficult to track engagement and campaign impact at the contact level. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Insightly CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

We struggled with managing outreach, tracking relationships, and building targeted contact lists, but now we can use Insightly CRM to send email campaigns, create filtered lists through reports, and link contacts, opportunities, and organizations in one place, which has improved organization, visibility into relationships, and overall efficiency. "Simple, Clean CRM That Keeps Sales Pipelines Organised"

What do you like best about Insightly CRM?

What I like best about Insightly CRM is how simple and easy it is to use. The UI is clean and straightforward, so it’s easy to keep track of records and client interactions without things feeling too complicated. The email reminders are also really helpful for staying on top of follow-ups and making sure nothing gets missed. I also like the Leads and Opportunities features, as they make it much easier to manage the sales pipeline and keep deals organised. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Insightly CRM?

One downside of Insightly CRM is that email reminders can sometimes be missed, which can affect follow-ups. It would also be useful to have better AI integration, such as automatically appending meeting notes or email summaries to client records to save time and improve record keeping. The Leads feature could be better suited to our sales process, as it would work more effectively if it were based around companies rather than individual names. Additionally, duplicate records could be managed better, as it can sometimes be difficult to spot and remove them efficiently. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Insightly CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

Insightly CRM helps us keep track of opportunities, client interactions, reminders, and notes all in one place. This makes it much easier to stay organised, manage follow-ups, and ensure nothing gets missed throughout the sales process. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.
